item.title: Richard Frank Ayo
item.description: October 16, 1936 – November 28, 2025 Richard Frank Ayo passed away on November 28th, 2025, at the age of 89. He was born on October 16th, 1936, in McCall, Louisiana.

item.title: Conrad Shipyard, SHI form LNG bunkering partnership
item.description: Conrad Shipyard photo Conrad Shipyard executive Johnny Conrad and Joonyun Kang, director of Samsung’s Eco Business Team, sign a memorandum of understanding under which the companies will work together in the LNG bunkering market. Morgan City’s Conrad Shipyard LLC and Samsung Heavy Industries Co. Ltd., another leading shipbuilder, have agreed to work together in LNG bunkering.
